top_signals.title: Record Run for US Stocks to Set Tone for Asia: Markets Wrap
top_signals.summary: A record-breaking rally on Wall Street may set the tone for Asian markets as traders focus on earnings, even as elevated oil prices threaten to keep interest rates and global bond yields higher for longer.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: Cramer says these blue-chip stocks are among the best ways to invest in the AI boom
top_signals.summary: Jim Cramer said established tech giants with strong businesses and multiple ways to benefit from AI are some of the best places to invest in the boom.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
